tools.name: search_roles
tools.description: Find Microsoft 365 and Azure built-in roles by name or description. Returns role ids for the other tools, a privilege tier and the role's RBAC Map page.

tools.name: get_role
tools.description: Full details for one role: description, privilege tier, permissions, the admin tasks it covers, its Microsoft Learn page and its RBAC Map page.

tools.name: find_roles_with_permission
tools.description: Reverse lookup: which roles grant a permission, least-privileged first. For Azure, pass an operation such as "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/listKeys/action" (wildcards and notActions are applied) or a pattern such as "Microsoft.KeyVault/*". For Microsoft 365, pass keywords such as "reset passwor

tools.name: compare_roles
tools.description: Compare 2 or 3 roles: the permissions they share and the permissions only one of them has, with each role's privilege tier.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Search the admin tasks RBAC Map maps to roles (e.g. "reset MFA", "create retention policy"), with the least-privileged roles that can do each one.

tools.name: recommend_roles
tools.description: Recommend the built-in roles that together cover a set of admin tasks, using the RBAC Map Role Builder algorithm. Get task ids from list_tasks first. "fewest-roles" (default) picks the smallest set; "least-privilege" prefers several narrow roles over one broad one.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Recently added, removed, renamed or re-permissioned Microsoft 365 and Azure roles, newest first. The same entries as RBAC Map's What's New feed.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "find_roles_with_permission" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
